notes: This materializes deterministic public coefficient, incidence, and diagonal seeds for each row.
The generated tilt has exactly three nonzero row entries per tilt column and is combined with Cauchy guard/base blocks over the row's prime field.

Compressed view rows now report route diagnostics: support-covered rows need a concrete hitting-set certificate, while lossy-budget rows report viewed-noise, viewed-separation, and multi-coordinate diagonal-amplification checks.

A guard-block lossy diagonal view is accepted when the selected prefix contains the full Cauchy guard block, the field is prime, the guard-block support distance meets the diagonal bad-seed bound, and the lossy noise/separation budget passes.
Passing rows should still be treated as candidates for deeper bounded dual-witness search and estimator work, not as deployed parameters.
